featured_title: Should You Sell on Corkscrew Road Before 14,500 More Homes Arrive? Southwest Florida 2026
featured_excerpt: Roughly 14,500 homes are already approved east of Estero's finished communities and mostly unbuilt, while the next two Corkscrew Road widenings sit on the adopted MPO 2050 plan's needs list. If you plan to sell within three or four years, that window narrows rather than widens.
others_caption: Also this week: Copperleaf at The Brooks, the Estero school enrollment guide, how to check the Village of Estero city limits, Spring Run at The Brooks, Copperleaf vs. Spring Run, and Belle Lago.
